spec_section_7_answers.execution_receipt_bundle_activation_cond: Outer L1372: process_step_ledger is not None OR force_receipt_bundle. Inner L1508-1521: force_receipt_bundle OR v150 true_completed OR (fixtures AND (executed|planned step ids) AND oracle_evaluated AND cleanup_ver AND env_restored). Then assemble + finalization.
spec_section_7_answers.why_unit_tests_pass_formal_fails: Gate A / V1.5.0 tests call operational_receipts APIs or evaluate_true_completed with synthetic complete receipt sets / forced booleans / force_receipt_bundle. Formal mainline never sets force_receipt_bundle and never copies plan_result step ID lists into observations, so _seek_true_completed stays false → empty bundle → no finalization → D=0.
spec_section_7_answers.experiments_with_real_steps_missing_ledg: Unlock-set ORACLE_NOT_VIOLATED experiments execute real steps and create ProcessStepLedger object, but Finalizer lacks process_step_ledger_id + observation step ID lists → container effectively invisible to bundle seek
